summary: Who may say what to whom, and what a listener owes onward. This table is the whole relationship layer between seats; contracts/seat-message.schema.json owns only the envelope, and neither reads inside a message body.

REPORT.plain_english: A builder telling its owner what it built. Evidence, never a verdict.

PLAN.means: Here is a bounded operation plan for the objective I was given.
PLAN.plain_english: An orchestrator handing back a sequence of operations, not results.

DISPATCH.means: Do this bounded operation under this grant.
DISPATCH.plain_english: Work going down the tree. The only act that travels downward from a non-root seat.

ATTEST.means: I looked at this myself, by a path independent of the builder, and it holds.
ATTEST.plain_english: A witness verdict. Requires INDEPENDENT: whoever built it cannot say this about it.

DISSENT.means: I looked at this myself and I disagree with the claim.
DISSENT.plain_english: A witness disagreeing. A valid and valuable outcome, and one no listener may drop.

UNATTESTABLE.means: I looked, and the claim cannot be verified as stated.
UNATTESTABLE.plain_english: Neither agreement nor disagreement: there is nothing here that could be checked. A claim with no defeating case usually lands here.

ASK.means: This needs judgement I do not hold. Here is the question.
ASK.plain_english: A question travelling up toward the root. It queues; it never blocks the asker or anyone else.

REFUSE.means: I will not do this, and here is the rule that forbids it.
REFUSE.plain_english: Refusal is a legal move for every seat, including downward-facing ones. It names a rule, not a preference.

STALL.means: There is no admissible route forward from here, and here is the proof.
STALL.plain_english: A proven BLOCKED claim. It carries all seven required fields or it is a gate, not a block.

AGGREGATE.means: Here are the statements below me, forwarded.
AGGREGATE.plain_english: The only act a control seat uses to move other seats' words upward. It moves nothing on its own: an aggregate proposes no standing, and every item it received must come out the other side unedited.

RATIFY.plain_english: Root only. The one act that can reach RATIFIED.

ACCEPT.means: I accept this finished, evidenced result.
ACCEPT.plain_english: Root only, and after the fact. Acceptance is never pre-approval (decisions/0023).

HOLD.means: I am holding this, and here is which of the admissible reasons applies.
HOLD.plain_english: Root only. A hold is stated with its reason; silence is not a hold.

root.plain_english: Bdo. Settles judgement. Nothing above it, so it speaks only downward: every question from below terminates here.

control.plain_english: Selects and dispatches work, then carries what comes back. It never builds, never witnesses, and never edits what it forwards.

orchestration.plain_english: Turns an objective into bounded operations and leases them out. It plans and sequences; it does not build and does not witness.

work.plain_english: Executes exactly one bounded operation, or witnesses one it did not execute. Which of the two it is doing is decided by relation_to_subject, never by a separate seat type: a work seat is a builder or a witness for a given operation, never both.

carriage_duties.rule: Every item_id present in an aggregated message must be present in the aggregate.
carriage_duties.plain_english: A listener owes its own listener everything it heard. Dropping a question, a dissent, a residual, or a proven stall is the failure this whole contract exists to catch.

carriage_duties.rule: A carried item forwarded under an existing item_id must be byte-identical to the item it forwards.
carriage_duties.plain_english: Summarising someone else's dissent is editing it. Add your own item if you have something to add; do not rewrite theirs.

carriage_duties.rule: No statement whose relation_to_subject is INDEPENDENT may be spoken by an actor_id that earlier spoke a PERFORMED statement about the same operation_id.
carriage_duties.plain_english: A build report cannot witness itself, and the same actor cannot change hats to say so.

generative_rule: A seat type absent from `seats` has no admissible acts, and an act absent from `acts` cannot be spoken. Adding a seat or an act is a change to this table alone: the message schema, the fixtures format, and the checker all read from here. Nothing in this file constrains a message body, and no checker reads inside one.
not_in_scope: The content, shape, length, or wording of a message body.
Whether a statement is true. Etiquette is about who may say a thing, never about whether it is so.
Settlement. Every act here proposes; the kernel and the root seat settle.
